overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating after its March 3 meeting was adjourned, but declined to find an intentional violation and ordered only future compliance given prior remedial steps.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Finance Committee kept deliberating on budget matters after its March 3 meeting had been adjourned.
allegations.key_passage: As this discussion involved a quorum of the Committee, and concerned a topic within the Committee’s jurisdiction, we find that the discussion violated the Open Meeting Law, as it took place after the March 3 meeting was adjourned.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the post-adjournment discussion was an intentional violation of the Open Meeting Law; the AG considered whether it was knowing.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore decline to find an intentional violation.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (no further relief ordered, as the Committee had already taken adequate remedial action).
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
